out_of_schema_notes: UF/DF has no designed experiment and the report defines no design space (an ExplicitNonClaim, with the reason the report gives). design_spaces is empty.

ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the set-point and NOR in force; the NOR of the number of diavolumes is one-sided, a minimum ('≥ 7 DV'), as the report prints it. ProcessParameter.PAR is the univariate PAR, which equals the range studied. rationale_for_criticality carries the classification argument of the report, which names the KPP class of TMP and the final DS concentration as a judgement that their effect on aggregate is too small to be practically relevant.

QualityAttribute records are the three attributes of the attribute table: aggregate and the acidic charge variants, measured in the final retentate, and residual DNA, not measured at the step and judged on the drug substance in the integrated process model. No step follows UF/DF, so the drug substance criterion applies directly and PCMP-001 defines no intermediate acceptance criterion.

proven_acceptable_ranges: one record per parameter and per attribute the PAR rests on (aggregate at manufacturing scale and the acidic charge variants as measured, each judged per individual result). par_at_setpoint is the PAR of the PAR table; par_nor_propagated is unset, because the step has no fitted model and the report says the second analysis of PCMP-001 §6.4 was not performed.

StatisticalModelFit: the fifteen slopes of the slope table (one per parameter and output, ModelTerm.effect the change across the range studied as printed), the exponential fit of the buffer exchange, and the main-effects fit of aggregate used for the verification of the PCMP-001 assumption (PD-010-08), judged on the first three criteria of PCMP-001 §7.2. A p-value printed as '< 0.001' has no float value.

acceptance_criteria: the report prints no criteria-change table. The in-force records are the drug substance criteria for aggregate, the acidic charge variants (both ends) and residual DNA, the buffer-exchange criterion as PD-010-07 records it (the minimum number of diavolumes with release of the drug substance against its formulation buffer limits; attribute 'buffer_exchange', not a CQA), and the aggregate criterion of the cation exchange pool (step 'cex') that the UF/DF allowance tightens. The superseded record is the upper limit alone against which Version 1.0 read the acidic charge variants (INV-001 finding 4).

PerformanceMeasure records: the step yield, the final concentration achieved in the series run at the target, and the residual process buffer at the minimum number of diavolumes, each on its sentence and its row of the reproducibility table. ControlStrategyElement records are the four numbered elements of Section 10.

Studies: S-UFDF-SDM (scale-down qualification), S-UFDF-UNI (the planned univariate study, which ran but left no result for any parameter effect) and S-UFDF-UNI2 (the further univariate study of the re-analysis, PD-010-01, on the second skid). None carries n_runs, which the corpus test reserves for the seeded DoE designs; the run counts are in the cited prose. Of the appendix rows only those that occur once in the document are used.

The schema has no record type for a discrepancy from the plan. PD-010-01 to PD-010-08 are report statements anchored on their rows of the discrepancy register; PD-010-01 also anchors S-UFDF-UNI2, PD-010-05 S-UFDF-SDM and PD-010-07 the buffer-exchange criterion.

The report records no deviation: a characterization study is not GMP manufacture, so the two events of execution are study events, under the numbers Version 1.0 gave them (DEV-010-01, DEV-010-02). They are Deviation records, the schema's only record type for an event of execution; no_impact_on_conclusions is true for both, as the conclusions state.

parameter_impacts_attribute and parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute: one assertion per parameter and measured attribute, on its row of the slope table. Residual DNA has none: the integrated process model gives the UF/DF parameters no effect on it. The residual process buffer, the step yield and the final concentration are process outputs, recorded as model fits and statements.
The equipment ids follow the PCP-010 Version 2.0 annex (equip:ufdf_sdm, equip:ufdf_membrane); the second skid of S-UFDF-UNI2 is equip:ufdf_sdm_skid2.
rhetorical_spans: authoring/rhetorical/PCR-010.spans.yaml, re-curated against the Version 2.0 text in the same pass as this builder. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 10, the last step of the A-Mab drug substance process. Ultrafiltration concentrates the filtrate pool of virus filtration, diafiltration at constant volume exchanges the process buffer for the formulation buffer, a second concentration brings the retentate to the drug substance target of 75 g/L and a buffer flush recovers it. The step can add to aggregate and to the acidic charge variants, is credited with no clearance of host cell protein, DNA or leached Protein A, and claims no viral clearance. Its product is the drug substance.

source_references.quote: Ultrafiltration and diafiltration (UF/DF) is Step 10, the last step of the A-Mab drug substance process.
It concentrates the antibody, exchanges the process buffer for the formulation buffer and delivers the drug substance at its target concentration of 75 g/L.
UF/DF is the last step of the train, and its product is the drug substance.
A second concentration brings the retentate to the drug substance target, and a buffer flush recovers it.
The step receives the filtrate pool of the small virus retentive filtration step.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 1: The bench-scale TFF model is qualified for aggregate under the approach of Section 3.1. Its offsets from manufacturing scale were applied to the results of the second skid. The discrepancy entry for that use (PD-010-01) accepts it because the skids share their design and their membrane and the offsets are small against the criteria (objective i).

source_references.quote: The bench-scale TFF model is qualified for aggregate under the approach of Section 3.1 .

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 2: Aggregate rises with the final DS concentration and with TMP, by 0.14 and 0.06 percentage points across the ranges studied. No effect of the number of diavolumes on aggregate was detected, and no slope of the acidic charge variants was significant (objective ii). The rise across the NORs tightens the criterion of the cation exchange pool to 4.90 % HMW.

source_references.quote: Aggregate rises with the final DS concentration and with TMP, by 0.14 and 0.06 percentage points across the ranges studied.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 3: The residual process buffer falls by a factor of 2.70 for each diavolume and is at most 0.091 % of the process buffer at the minimum of 7 DV. The buffer-exchange criterion of PCP-010 could not be judged as planned. The buffer exchange is controlled by the minimum number of diavolumes and by the release of the drug substance against the limits of its formulation buffer. Objective (iii) is not met, because the number of diavolumes at which the retentate reaches the formulation buffer was not established.

source_references.quote: The residual process buffer falls by a factor of 2.70 for each diavolume and is at most 0.091 % of the process buffer at the minimum of 7 DV.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 4: Every result met the drug substance criteria for aggregate and the acidic charge variants. The PARs are 7–10 DV, 10–15 psi and 65–85 g/L, each equal to its range studied (objective iv).

source_references.quote: Every result met the drug substance criteria for aggregate and the acidic charge variants.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 5: The three parameters are KPPs, and the step has no CPP. TMP and the final DS concentration raise aggregate by 0.04 and 0.07 percentage points across their NORs, against a margin of 4.21 percentage points to the criterion, and their KPP class rests on the size of these effects. The drug substance has a Cpk of 15.7 for aggregate, 1.05 for the acidic charge variants and 7.3 for residual DNA in the integrated process model. The Cpk of the acidic charge variants lies between the minimum and the target of PCMP-001. At the mean of this study it would be 0.63, so it depends on the level that the upstream steps deliver (objective v).

source_references.quote: The three parameters are KPPs, and the step has no CPP.
